questions.question: If 2x + y = 8 and xy = 6, then find the value of 4x 2 + y 2
questions.questionHtml: If 2x + y = 8 and xy = 6, then find the value of 4x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>
questions.solution:
Given:

2x + y = 8 and xy = 6

Formula used:

a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 - 2ab

Calculation:

The expression 4x2 + y2  can be written as 4x2 + y2 = (2x + y)2 - 4xy

Substitute (2x + y) = 8 and xy = 6, in the above equation.

4x2 + y2 = 82 - 4 × 6 = 64 - 24 = 40

Therefore, if 2x + y = 8 and xy = 6, then find the value of 4x2 + y2 is 40.

questions.question: Simplify the expression: (c + d) 2 - (c - d) 2
questions.questionHtml:
Simplify the expression: 

(c + d)2 - (c - d)2

options.html: 2(c2 + d2)

questions.solution:
Formula Used :

x2 - y2 = (x + y) (x - y)

Calculation:

⇒ (c + d)2 - (c - d)2

⇒ (c + d + c - d) (c + d -(c - d))

⇒ 2c × (c + d - c + d)

⇒ 2c × 2d = 4cd

∴ The simplified value is 4cd.

Alternate MethodFormula Used :

(x + y)2 = x2 + y2 + 2xy

(x - y)2 = x2 + y2 - 2xy

Calculation:

⇒ (c + d)2 - (c - d)2

⇒ c2 + d2 + 2cd - (c2 + d2 - 2cd)

⇒ c2 + d2 + 2cd - c2 - d2 + 2cd

⇒ 4cd

∴ The simplified value is 4cd.

questions.question: If \(\rm k^4+\frac{1}{k^4}=194\) , then what is the value of \(\rm k^3+\frac{1}{k^3}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If \(\rm k^4+\frac{1}{k^4}=194\), then what is the value of \(\rm k^3+\frac{1}{k^3}\)?
questions.solution:
We know, • If k4 + 1/k4  = a then k2 + 1/k2 = √(a + 2)

• If k2 + 1/k2 = b then k + 1/k = √(b + 2)

• If k + 1/k = c then k3 + 1/k3 = c3 - 3c

So, k4 + 1/k4 = 194 then  k2 + 1/k2 = √196 = 14 so, k + 1/k = √16 = 4

Then, k3 + 1/k3 = 43 - 12 = 52

questions.question: If x – 1/x = 3√2, then x 2 + 1/x 2 is equal to∶
questions.questionHtml: If x – 1/x = 3√2, then x<sup>2</sup> + 1/x<sup>2</sup> is equal to∶
questions.solution:
Short Trick∶

We know that, if x – 1/x = a, then x2 + 1/x2 = a2 + 2

Here x – 1/x = 3√2

∴ x2 + 1/x2 = (3√2)2 + 2 = 18 + 2 = 20

Detailed Solution∶

We know that, (a – b)2 = a2 + b2 – 2ab

Here a = x, b = 1/x, (a – b) = x – 1/x = 3√2

\(\therefore \;{\left( {x - \frac{1}{x}} \right)^2}\; = \;{x^2}\; + \;\frac{1}{{{x^2}}} - 2\;\)

\(\Rightarrow \;{\left( {3\surd 2} \right)^2}\; = \;{x^2}\; + \;\frac{1}{{{x^2}}} - 2\;\)

\(\Rightarrow \;{x^2}\; + \;\frac{1}{{{x^2}}}\; = \;18\; + \;2\; = \;20\)

questions.questionHtml: If m and n are two positive real numbers such that 9m<sup>2</sup> + n<sup>2</sup> = 40 and mn = 4, then the value of 3m + n is:
questions.solution:
9m² + n² = 40, on adding 6mn both sides, we get,

9m² + n² + 6mn = 40 + 6mn ⇒ (3m)² + n² + 2(3m)n = 40 + 6(4) ⇒ (3m + n)² = 64 ⇒ 3m + n = √64 = 8

questions.question: If a = 2b = 8c and a + b + c = 13 then the value of \(\frac{{\sqrt {{a^2} + {b^2} + {c^2}} }}{{2c}}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If a = 2b = 8c and a + b + c = 13 then the value of \(\frac{{\sqrt {{a^2} + {b^2} + {c^2}} }}{{2c}}\) is:
questions.solution:
a = 2b = 8c

Let a = 2b = 8c = k

a = k

2b = k

⇒ b = k/2

8c = k

⇒ c = k/8

Ratio of a : b : c = k : k/2 : k/8 = 8 : 8k/2 : 8k/8 = 8 : 4 : 1

Now,

\(\frac{{\sqrt {{a^2} + {b^2} + {c^2}} }}{{2c}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt {{8^2} + {4^2} + {1^2}} }}{2}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt {64 + 16 + 1} }}{2}\)

⇒ √81/2

⇒ 9/2

Short Trick:

a = 2b = 8c

a : b : c = 1 : 1/2 : 1/8 = 8 : 4 : 1

Now,

\(\frac{{\sqrt {{a^2} + {b^2} + {c^2}} }}{{2c}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt {{8^2} + {4^2} + {1^2}} }}{2}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt {64 + 16 + 1} }}{2}\)

⇒ √81/2

questions.question: If a and b are two positive real numbers such that a + b = 20 and ab = 4, then the value of a 3 + b 3 is:
questions.questionHtml: If a and b are two positive real numbers such that a + b = 20 and ab = 4, then the value of a<sup>3 </sup>+ b<sup>3</sup> is:
questions.solution:
Given:

a and b are two positive real numbers such that a + b = 20 and ab = 4. We have to find the value of a3 + b3

Formula Used:

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 – 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 – 3ab(a + b)

⇒ a3 + b3 = (20)3 – 3 × 4 × 20       [∵ Given a + b = 20 and ab = 4]

⇒ a3 + b3 = 20 × (202 – 12)

⇒ a3 + b3 = 20 × (400 – 12)

⇒ a3 + b3 = 20 × 388

⇒ a3 + b3 = 7760

∴ Value of a3 + b3 is 7760
